---
title: "The IPBES long-term vision of data and knowledge management"
subtitle: "Version {{< meta version >}} · {{< meta release_date >}}"
# Version, release date, release notes and DOI are not stored here: scripts/release.py
# adds them from the release form. title, produced_by, publisher, contact_email, editors
# and next_version (the version this text is prepared as, chosen at export) are updated
# by the Google Doc import; the text itself is in _content.md.
next_version: "2.0"
produced_by: "IPBES task force on knowledge and data"
publisher: "IPBES secretariat, Bonn, Germany"
contact_email: "tsu.data@ipbes.net"
editors:
  - name: "Rainer M Krug"
    institution: "University of Zurich"
    orcid: "0000-0002-7490-0066"
  - name: "Aidin Niamir"
    institution: "Senckenberg Society for Nature Research"
    orcid: "0000-0003-4511-3407"
zenodo:
  concept_doi: "10.5281/zenodo.5513473"          # production "all versions" DOI
  sandbox_concept_doi: "10.5072/zenodo.472195"   # used when ZENODO_TARGET=sandbox
  access_right: "open"
  license: "cc-by-4.0"
format:
  html:
    output-file: index.html
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    format-links: false
  pdf:
    papersize: a4
    toc: true
    number-sections: true
    geometry:
      - left=2.0cm
      - right=2.5cm
      - top=1.0cm
      - bottom=1.4cm
      - includeheadfoot
    classoption:
      - titlepage
    template-partials:
      - templates/title.tex
execute:
  echo: false
---

```{r}
# Release values come from scripts/release.py as IPBES_* environment variables.
release <- function(key) Sys.getenv(paste0("IPBES_", toupper(key)))
meta <- rmarkdown::metadata

version <- if (nzchar(release("version"))) release("version") else "draft"
release_notes <- if (nzchar(release("release_notes"))) release("release_notes") else "Not released yet."
release_date <- if (nzchar(release("release_date"))) release("release_date") else "unreleased"
release_year <- if (nzchar(release("release_year"))) release("release_year") else format(Sys.Date(), "%Y")
doi <- release("doi")
concept_doi <- meta$zenodo$concept_doi

doi_text <- if (nzchar(doi)) {
  sprintf("[%s](https://doi.org/%s)", doi, doi)
} else if (nzchar(release("prerelease"))) {
  "None (pre-release)"
} else {
  "**Will be inserted upon release**"
}
editor_text <- paste(vapply(meta$editors, function(e) e$name, ""), collapse = ", ")
citation_line <- sprintf(
  "IPBES (%s): *%s*, version %s, %s (eds.). %s. DOI: %s",
  release_year, meta$title, version, editor_text, meta$publisher, doi_text
)
```

\newpage

## Release Metadata {.unnumbered}

- **Version:** `r version`
- **Release date:** `r release_date`
- **DOI:** `r doi_text`
- **Latest-version DOI:** `r sprintf("[%s](https://doi.org/%s)", concept_doi, concept_doi)`
- **PDF:** `r if (knitr::is_html_output()) "<a href=\"assets/IPBES-Data-Management-Vision-latest.pdf\" target=\"_blank\" rel=\"noopener noreferrer\">Download PDF</a>" else "Download the latest PDF from the website."`
